resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO or equivalent open-source DFT code supporting HSE

access.notes: Any DFT code capable of HSE and PBE functionals (e.g., GPAW, ABINIT) is acceptable.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials for Sr, V, O, Ba, Sc, W

access.notes: GBRV pseudopotentials or equivalent PBE/HSE-compatible PAW pseudopotentials.

resources.name: Crystal structures for SrVO3 (cubic Pm-3m), SrO (rocksalt), BaO (rocksalt), Sc2O3 (bixbyite), W (bcc)

access.notes: Structures can be retrieved from the Materials Project (e.g., SrVO3 mp-xxx) or constructed from literature data.
